authors_reviews.title: Great Tick Removal Kit to Keep on Hand!
authors_reviews.text: Great little kit! Unfortunately ticks seem to be multiplying like crazy these days. This is a great little kit to keep in your backpack, car, or bathroom. Removing ticks carefully and completely is super important so that you don’t leave any of the ticks mouth or head in your skin (bad for disease transmission and infection!). The tools in this kit make it easy to remove them correctly, and the identification card is useful too! Always remember to take photos for tick identification after removal, and if a tick has been attached for a while, send it in to your local lab for lyme and infectious disease testing to be on the safe side!
authors_reviews.author: Chris

authors_reviews.title: This kit is well made and a great value for the price. Buy one today.
authors_reviews.text: If you’ve spent (or are planning to spend) any time hiking, camping, or generally enjoying the outdoors this summer, chances are you’ve read our story on the best products for preventing tick bites. But what if you try everything you can to stop them, and a tick still sinks its pincers into you? Cases of tick-borne illnesses in the United States grew by more than 6,000 between the years 2016 and 2017, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. And knowing how to quickly and properly remove a tick without leaving its mouthparts behind is extremely important if you don’t want to contract one of those illnesses (which include Lyme disease).This amazing kit includes a stainless steel V-shaped tick remover, super-fine-tip tweezers, a leatherette pouch, and a free tick identification card. The tools work amazingly well.First use the V-shape tool to grasp the tick near the skin and lift it out. The super-fine tweezers are designed for removing small ticks and nymphs. This works great for that purpose.The kit is compact and comes in a leatherette pouch, making it easy to carry in a backpack, glove compartment, or purse. It is a great value for the price. Very well made. It is so easy to use if you follow the instructions.If you hike, have pets, or live in a rural area this kit is perfect. I have one for the house and one for the car.
authors_reviews.author: Richard Bissell

authors_reviews.title: A Must-Have for Outdoors – Works Fast and Easy
authors_reviews.text: This is a must-have for anyone who spends time outdoors. I picked it up for peace of mind, and it already proved itself.Used it on my dog, and the tick came off super easy with no hassle. The tools grip well and make removal quick and clean, which is exactly what you want in that situation.The stainless steel tools feel solid and durable, not flimsy, and the leather case is a nice touch for keeping everything together and easy to carry. The included ID card is also useful if you’re not sure what kind of tick you’re dealing with.Overall, simple, effective, and something every outdoor person should have in their kit.
